owner_approval: 2026-09-19 用户同意保留原版、按实际文件修订安装配方；测试和参考集合不变
original_install: python -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel GitPython; python -m pip install "cython<3.0.0" && python -m pip install --no-build-isolation pyyaml==5.4.1; python -m pip install git+https://github.com/iterative/mock-ssh-server.git || true; python -m pip install -r tests/requirements.txt || true; python -m pip install -r test-requirements.txt || true; python -m pip install -e ".[tests,dev,all_remotes,all,testing]"; python -m pip install "numpy<=1.20"; python -m pip install "pytest<8";
revised_install:
rh2_recipe_install() {
  for req in tests/requirements.txt test-requirements.txt; do
    if [ -f "$req" ]; then
      python -m pip install -r "$req" || return $?
    else
      echo "RH2_RECIPE_OPTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS_ABSENT=$req"
    fi
  done
  python -m pip install -e ".[tests,all]"
}
rh2_recipe_install
rationale: 不存在的可选requirements文件不尝试安装；若候选提供了文件则读取并传播其安装失败。
setup.py实际提供tests和all extras；移除不存在的dev/all_remotes/testing extra名。
基础镜像已含工具链和兼容运行依赖；评分不再无界升级pip/wheel/GitPython或从Git远端重新安装mock-ssh-server。
离线构建wheel只作为资产；保留依赖解析，不使用--no-deps掩盖候选的新依赖。
verification_required: 新的候选依赖从安装前absent变为安装后存在
完整安装日志无未解释失败；剩余依赖冲突另修，不按reward单独认定安装通过
